title: 第17章 拔刀吧有萝莉控第18章 这并不是真正的快乐
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
数分钟之后。
“也就是说，因为今天血月降临的原因，你来不及回家，然后被……被困在了雾隐大街？而且还差一点被一个恶灵吃掉，是你身边的这个男生救了你？”
琼斯犹疑而蛋疼地打听清楚了他们的情况。
花耶瞪着大眼睛，乖乖地坐在林恩的身边，接受着审问。
当然，虽然他确实可怕了一点，甚至很有可能会是某种怪物，但是救命之恩什么的，她也绝对肯定是不会把他的情况泄露出去的。
“你确定？”
他怀疑地望向他们。
花耶瞪着眼，悄悄地看了林恩一眼，道：
“当……当然了啊！我刚才说的都是真的！我们走的好好的，结果突然就被你们的人包围了起来！真的很吓人的！”
琼斯深吸一口气道：“那爱好男生这件事呢？”
花耶一愣，道：
“不对吗？我姐姐和我说过呀，她的队长一直在心底里爱慕着……”
“爱慕着谁？”
周围的驱魔师全都愣愣地侧耳倾听。
砰——
一声枪响。
琼斯闪电般掏出来的左轮冒着黑烟，随机开了一枪。
琼斯咬牙，举着枪道：“这事谁听谁死！”
那些驱魔师立刻（?Д?）ノ地飞速后退点头，立刻捂住了自己的耳朵。
“……”

但是毫无疑问，能爆出出这种究极猛料，并且他们的队长还做出这种剧烈反应的，应该毫无疑问是正儿八经的人类没错了。
他们刚才真的是差一点就应激地当做怪物杀掉了！
琼斯深吸了一口气。
花耶他当然认识。
她是他们一个队员的妹妹，也是【幽织】家族的小小姐。
但是大半夜的情况下，一个小萝莉跟着一个裸男出来，怎么看怎么都感觉很有问题才是啊。
他的目光严肃地望向她身边的林恩。
“你确定？花耶，你姐姐是我的队员，我有责任也有义务保护你，但是他，大晚上只裹着个床单的人……花耶，你不要怕，这里都是驱魔人，如果你受到了拐带就请说出来……”
毕竟不管怎么看，都不太像是一个正经人，反而像是某种半夜诱拐女孩的萝莉控。
咔哒——
他的大拇指一挑，露出了刀鞘前的半截锋刃，低声道；
“我们肯定是会给你做主的！”
因为萝莉控在他们这里……那可是需要拔刀的。
林恩蛋疼道：“有没有搞错？做好事也要被怀疑吗？实话实说！告诉他我们是什么关系！”
花耶顿时一个激灵，（.;?;:益:;?;.）地抓着小手手，冷汗刷刷地往下掉。
content_en:
A few minutes later.
"In other words, because of the blood moon coming today, you were too late to go home, and then you were...trapped on Kirigakure Street? And you were almost eaten by an evil spirit. Was it the boy next to you who saved you?"
Jones hesitantly and painfully inquired about their situation.
With wide eyes, Hua Ye sat obediently next to Lin En and accepted the interrogation.
Of course, although he was indeed a bit scary, and might even be some kind of monster, she was absolutely certain that he would not reveal his situation as a life-saving grace.
"Are you sure?"
He looked at them suspiciously.
Hua Ye stared, glanced at Lin En quietly, and said:
"Of course... of course! What I just said is true! We were walking well, but suddenly we were surrounded by your people! It was really scary!"
Jones took a deep breath and said, "What about liking boys?"
Huaye was stunned and said:
"Isn't that right? My sister told me that her captain has always been in love with her from the bottom of her heart..."
"Who do you admire?"
The exorcists around him all listened blankly.
Bang——
There was a gunshot.
Jones took out the revolver with black smoke at lightning speed and fired a shot at random.
Jones gritted his teeth, raised his gun and said, "Whoever listens to this matter will die!"
The exorcists immediately backed away quickly, nodded, and immediately covered their ears.
"..."
But there is no doubt that the person who can break out such extremely violent information and have their captain react so violently must be a serious human being.
They were really almost killed as monsters in a panic just now!
Jones took a deep breath.
Of course he knows Huaye.
She is the sister of one of their team members and the youngest lady of the [Yuzhi] family.
But in the middle of the night, a little loli followed a naked man out. No matter how you look at it, it feels very problematic.
His eyes looked seriously at Linn beside her.
"Are you sure? Huaye, your sister is my team member. I have the responsibility and obligation to protect you, but he is a person who only wears a sheet at night... Huaye, don't be afraid, there are exorcists here. If you have been abducted, please tell us..."
After all, no matter how you look at him, he doesn't look like a serious person, but rather like some kind of lolicon who abducts girls in the middle of the night.
Click——
He raised his thumb, revealing half of the blade in front of the scabbard, and whispered;
"We will definitely make the decision for you!"
Because lolita is controlled by them... that requires drawing out the sword.
Lin En said in pain, "Have you made a mistake? Do you have to be suspected even if you do good deeds? Tell the truth! Tell him what our relationship is!"
Huaye suddenly became excited, (.;?;:Yi:;?;.) clutching her little hands, cold sweat falling down.
